log_entries: I met a strange Dark Elf with glowing eyes during my travels, who called himself Llavados. He told me that someone was in danger, and he needed my help to save them. Before explaining further, however, he killed himself, instructing me to "take the part that glows."

Apparently, Llavados is a 'fabricant', and this object is actually his soul and life force. He has instructed me to head to place called Stonehole Mine, southwest of Dawnstar, at the bottom of which I will find his friends. I'm not really sure what is going on.

Apparently, Llavados is a 'fabricant', and this object is actually his soul and life force. He has instructed me to head to place called Stonehole Mine, southwest of Dawnstar, at the bottom of which I will find his friends. I'm not really sure what is going on.
After defeating the poltergeists within Stonehole Mine, I discovered a mysterous lift leading deeper down. Llavados wants me to take it down to the bottom.

objectives.text: Take the glowing object from Llavados' body
Travel to Stonehole Mine in The Pale
Reach the bottom of Stonehole Mine

log_entries: I have arrived at Llavados' home. It is a strange town that seems to hover over large mechanisms. Apparently I am in Sotha Sil, or rather, a subsection of it called Lull-mor. I have been told to talk to Numinar, the person in charge here. He can be found in the town's large, central building.

Numinar has told me that his order, the Chronographers, maintain the mechanisms that run the world. One of these, Snow-Throat, has begun to die, and they suspect that someone from the surface is interfering with it. Numinar has reluctantly tasked me with collecting data on the three possible suspects. I am to wear a visor that will allow me to see three special slots around Skyrim, then install in each of them a peg, which I will then hit with a hammer until they start working. The slots can be found at the Thalmor Embassy, High Hrothgar, and the College of Winterhold.
I have successfully installed all three pegs, and must return to Numinar to see the results.
The Analyst has confirmed that the Thalmor are responsible for the mysterious activities that have been concerning Numinar. Numinar wants me to wait until he comes up with a plan.

objectives.text: Meet with Numinar in the large building at the center of Lull-Mor
Install a peg near High Hrothgar
Install a peg near the College of Winterhold
Install a peg near the Thalmor Embassy
Convince the Analyst to help you
Return to Numinar

full_name: The Mer In The High Castle

log_entries: Numinar wants me to disguise myself as a Thalmor agent using clothes he has given me, and infiltrate their base at Whitehorn Pass to retrieve information about what they are actually doing with the Throat of the World. Rather than travel by foot, I must head to the large spiked building in Lull-Mor and operate something called an "Upgate".

The Upgate is a large teleport machine operated by a fabricant named Subori. Unfortunately, I cannot use it at the moment, because when Llavados went through it to retrieve me, he flooded the place with butter (for reasons I really don't want to contemplate) and some deposits remain. If I can clear out the butter from the bottom of the Upgate, I can use it.
I have cleaned out the butter deposits from the Upgate, now to talk to Subori.
The Upgate is repaired. Whitehorn Pass awaits.
Whitehorn Pass looms before me. I must enter it, and discover just what is going on. The disguise provided to me should help, as will the forged message, but once I am inside, I will be on my own.
Success! The guard has bought my façade, now I must find out just what is going on in this place. I should watch my step though.

The captain of Whitehorn, a deranged mystic named Archeron, discovered me poking around in his labs! It is clear, however, that Archeron seems to know about Snow-Throat and the World Mechanism. I've been captured, and he intends to use me in one of his insane experiments. I must find a way out somehow, but I must still find out just what he plans!

I have discovered Archeron's plans alongside a key to escape this dungeon. It seems that he intends to reach the magics that control the Throat of the World, and destroy them in the name of his strange sciences. I must return to Numinar quickly, and show this to him! Though I should probably find my things first - I suspect there will be no coming back here later. Llavados said they were in a closet near the entrance.

My mission was both a success and a failure. We have learned Archeron's plans to reach the Stone of Snow-Throat, but Archeron discovered me and is now on alert. Even so, Numinar seems optimistic that we will reach the Stone before Archeron.

objectives.text: Head to the Upgate station
Clear out the butter deposits from the bottom of the Upgate
Return to Subori and activate the Upgate
Go through the Upgate
Present your papers to the gate guard and enter Whitehorn
Find some sort of plans indicating what the Thalmor intend at Whitehorn Pass
Find a way out
Discover Archeron's plans
Recover your items, escape Whitehorn Pass, and return to Numinar at Lull-Mor

log_entries: Numinar intends to mine a tunnel to where the Stone is located, where he hopes to set a trap for Archeron when he arrives. However, the machine that will mine the tunnel requires a special machine part that may only be found in an old area of Sotha Sil called "The Boiling Foundry". An entrance to it used to be located in the elevator station. Perhaps I can find a way back in somehow.
I have managed to reach the Boiling Foundry. Now I need to locate the drillbit somewhere in here and return it to Numinar.
After a long trek through the still-working Foundry, I managed to salvage the titanium drillbit from an old machine. I should return it to Numinar.
I have delivered the drillbit to Numinar. Now I just need to wait while the Chronographers dig a tunnel to the Stone.

objectives.text: Find a way into the Boiling Foundry
Find the titanium drillbit
Return the drillbit to Numinar

log_entries: Numinar has told me that while digging to the Stone, the drill team broke through a section of Sotha Sil's catacombs and were attacked by fabricant undead. I have been tasked with heading to the site and clearing the area of threats, while also figuring out why the normally passive undead would attack.

After defeating the Unwound Titan, the arena collapsed. I would have died, if not for the intervention of someone called Divayth Fyr and his friend Yagrum. Taking me back to Numinar, they explained that a saboteur is loose in Lull-Mor and we must watch our backs. I should confer with Numinar about this.

After defeating the Unwound Titan, the arena collapsed. I would have died, if not for the intervention of someone called Divayth Fyr and his friend Yagrum. Taking me back to Numinar, they explained that a saboteur is loose in Lull-Mor and we must watch our backs. Numinar is confident that he can handle the situation without my help now that Fyr and Yagrum are here, and has no further need for me until they reach the Cave.

objectives.text: Clear out the digsite
Find out why the fabricant undead are attacking
Talk to Numinar
